text: The purpose of this report is to seek further instructions related to a development application for a site that contains several heritage resources, and a related ongoing appeal at the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal.

City Council on July 14, 15 and 16, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 1, 2021) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendices A, B and C to the report (June 1, 2021) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 1, 2021) from the City Solicitor remain confidential as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
